title: Clarify bounded metadata version windows versus request-tail funding
outcome: Source-owner contract documentation distinguishes the62s version process cap from unchanged request funding and explicitly retains the slow-source-stage tail limitation.
acceptance: Host-adapter documentation and the matching acceptance budget comment describe a separately bounded version process, distinguish it from the unchanged request admission budget, and explicitly disclose that an unchanged slow source stage can still consume the mandatory tail.
Wording is checked against actual owner/phase/request code by review; no source deadline behavior is altered and no Markdown phrase or instruction-content test is added.
